description: Hosted-render the REAL worker course player (server-driven pinned Chromium — no local browser) into desktop/mobile PNG captures plus ARIA snapshot, diagnostics, and a provenance manifest. Captures the session’s CURRENT focus (target fields are an assertion, never navigation). Evidence class is SIMULATED_WORKER_PREVIEW and zero canonical worker state is written. The most relevant PNG is returned inline when within client limits; every artifact also returns a short-lived signed resource link. Requires lms:write.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable idempotency key. Reuse only for the identical operation.

name: opentrain_lms_render_preview
